The article states that sauna use has been proposed as an alternative to exercise for people unable to engage in physical activity due to chronic disease or physical limitations. It also describes how sauna use increases cardiac output and induces physiological responses similar to moderate-to-vigorous exercise. Therefore, heart surgery patients who cannot run on treadmills (an example of physical limitation) may benefit from sauna use as an alternative means to achieve some cardiovascular benefits.

Final answer: (A)
